name: raahsetu
description: RaahSetu 2.0 — fleet operations, constrained route optimization (OptiRoute), GreenFleet estimates and dispatch control tower.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup:ci: npm ci && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
